zh.title: 2026M8·加更——长上下文和推理能力，对人也很重要

sections.label: 1.【习以为常】模型能读的东西越来越多，我们已经忘了这曾经是一件很酷的事情
2.【容量幻觉】上下文窗口很长，不等于真正拥有长上下文能力
3.【生成过剩】模型的内容生产能力，已经超过了很多人的内容消费能力
4.【信息丢失】人也会在长文章、长会议和长期项目里忘记最开始的问题
5.【推理外包】模型替你多想一会儿，不代表你因此获得了推理能力
6.【共同进化】AI可能没有抹平人与人的差距，反而把差距转移到了阅读、推理和判断上

en.title: 2026M8 Bonus Edition — Long Context and Reasoning Matter for Humans Too

sections.label: 1. [Taking It for Granted] Models Can Read More and More, and We Have Forgotten How Cool That Once Felt
2. [The Capacity Illusion] A Long Context Window Is Not the Same as Real Long-Context Capability
3. [Generation Surplus] Models Can Produce More Content Than Many People Can Consume
4. [Information Loss] People Also Forget the Original Question in Long Articles, Long Meetings, and Long-Term Projects
5. [Outsourcing Reasoning] A Model Thinking Longer for You Does Not Mean You Have Acquired Reasoning Ability
6. [Co-evolution] AI May Not Eliminate Differences Between People; It May Move Those Differences into Reading, Reasoning, and Judgment
1.【保持主见】在职业生涯的早期，不要听HR和猎头的建议，也不要听2023年前毕业的前辈的建议
2.【内自省也】绝大多数公司、绝大多数部门，牛逼的人总是少数，大部分人很普通、甚至一半的人“有些菜”
3.【追求硬核】区分经验和能力，经验多不等于能力强
4.【创造价值】选择大趋势上的非共识，做难而有价值的事情，不为了和别人不一样而不一样
5.【迎浪而上】在快速变化的行业内，必须拥抱不确定性，且敢于做选择
6.【底线思维】考虑极端场景的最差结果可不可以接受，可以就上
1. [Think for Yourself] Early in your career, do not simply follow the advice of HR, recruiters, or people who graduated before 2023
2. [Look Inward] Exceptional people are always a minority; in most companies and teams, most people are ordinary, and perhaps half are not very good
3. [Pursue Substance] Distinguish experience from ability; more experience does not mean stronger ability
4. [Create Value] Take non-consensus positions within major trends, and do difficult, valuable work—not different work merely for the sake of being different
5. [Meet the Wave] In a fast-changing industry, embrace uncertainty and dare to choose
6. [Downside Thinking] If you can accept the worst plausible outcome, act
